requirements.criterion: Trimmed nonempty Unicode names are greeted; blank input is rejected.
Initialization validates identity, changes configuration and clears inherited approvals while preserving source; CI rejects a mismatched actual repository identity.
Explicit authorized setup applies strict PR/host/admin protection, exposes inspection/API/incomplete-response failures and preserves existing rules for explicit reconciliation.
requirements.gap: Real hosted protection setup and account-plan differences need current API evidence.

requirements.criterion: UI expert proposal precedes implementation; material ambiguity waits for user, exact authorized corrections proceed. Rendered acceptance is separate.
requirements.gap: Policy/tabletop review only. No product UI, visual baseline or measured latency is supplied.

requirements.criterion: Concrete case mappings, canonical test fingerprints, scenario dimensions and gaps stay fresh for test additions/edits/removals.
requirements.gap: Default inventory supports Python unittest. Other language/framework adapters require implementation and verification.

requirements.criterion: Two distinct fresh-agent approvals bind to canonical staged/committed candidate and gate real pushes; changed content rejects.
requirements.gap: Records cannot authenticate identity/independence. Actual fresh reviews and hosted PR protection are separate evidence.

requirements.criterion: Preserve bytes/originals and reject unsafe, corrupt, missing, unexpected, changed or overwritten archives. Availability and failed-run scope stay explicit.
requirements.gap: Live Actions retention/expiry/download and durable external availability are not proved by local archive tests.

requirements.criterion: Argument-array commands preserve literals/failure logs; missing/invalid/source-mismatched results fail and actual statuses remain separate.
requirements.gap: Configured reference stack only; product build/E2E/device adapters require explicit setup.

requirements.criterion: Current host counts, coverage/gaps, reports, artifacts and archive/source hashes bind before publish; stale reviews, mismatches and existing release refuse. Exact publication export/import preserves arbitrary configured extensions and dot-prefixed filenames without intermediate directories.
requirements.gap: Publication tests use synthetic local fixtures and mocked GitHub. Real Actions/release publication must be recorded separately.

requirements.criterion: Concise README, separate changelog, onboarding, shared design/architecture and feature diagrams retain valid links and explicit verification limits. Filesystem aliases normalize consistently so Windows short/long paths report link findings without crashing.
requirements.gap: Rendered diagram inspection and novice onboarding are manual; no application visual/performance or device claim.

requirements.criterion: Bounded current code-review-graph context and safe adaptive search routing for Claude/Codex coding and review.
requirements.gap: Native client hook activation/trust requires session restart and Codex /hooks. Shell interception deliberately targets simple symbol searches; exact/complex searches remain available. Large repositories beyond configured budgets fall back explicitly.

requirements.criterion: Idempotent backed-up user installation preserves unrelated settings, permissions and native trust.
requirements.gap: Host fixtures exercise installation and direct hook payloads; native trust is never fabricated or bypassed. POSIX private-mode regression runs on Ubuntu CI and is explicitly skipped on Windows; Windows ACL preservation beyond normal inherited user-directory protection is not certified.

requirements.criterion: Release-only Graphify AST and structural document snapshot excludes unrelated inputs and binds source/checksums.
requirements.gap: Default release graph is local AST plus explicit text headings/links and file coverage, not semantic document inference. Actual hosted release publication is unrun until requested.

requirements.criterion: Latest approved UI catalog rejects missing, altered or stale reference evidence and source fingerprints.
requirements.gap: Starter has no product UI. Approval metadata is an attestation; actual rendered review and project-specific screen/rotation/input coverage must be supplied during adoption.

requirements.criterion: Dedicated coding practice documents targeted iteration, complete required candidate checks, conservative scenario selection, valid evidence reuse, safe parallel work, final candidate freeze, timing/rerun reasons and reusable template alignment without weakening fresh approvals.
requirements.gap: Documentation policy only; manual scenario walkthrough and link/coverage validation do not prove faster execution or agent compliance. Scenario selectors, CI deduplication/caching and timing instrumentation remain pending implementation. No runtime, device or visual behavior changed.

requirements.criterion: Local bounded command supervision preserves live stdout/stderr, progress/status, explicit deadlines and failure/cancellation outcomes including post-command monitoring faults; independent observation never controls work or fabricates progress/success.
requirements.gap: Host fixtures target streaming before exit, byte preservation, Windows/POSIX owned-descendant cleanup, failures/limits, extraction faults, quiet/stale state and observer detachment. Actual platform execution is separate. No cloud/model telemetry, automatic retries or new per-scenario Android producer instrumentation. Device restoration uses mocked host fixtures until live verification.

requirements.criterion: Source-linked whole-system/component overview and feature overview/sequence atlas stay reconciled; every task screens architecture impact and architecture-affecting or uncertain changes obtain a fresh expert approach review before dependent work, with material questions/departures resolved separately from UI and final reviews.
requirements.gap: Source/render inspection and workflow scenario walkthrough are manual. No automated gate authenticates expert judgment or guarantees diagram semantics/completeness; documentation does not certify runtime behavior. No new device or product UI verification is implied.

requirements.criterion: Raw personal/device evidence is rejected from tracked paths and public-host input; private local capture remains allowed. Publication scope is current host run only; explicit withdrawal does not certify missing evidence.
requirements.gap: Guard checks paths and capture signatures, not all semantic private text or encoded data. Reviewed synthetic fixtures remain a human obligation. Remote history replacement, cached PR refs and clone cleanup need separate verified maintenance.
